ane-ugarit-rs-19-0053-scribe-brother-ang: The scribe Matkali-Nabû to the scribe Naheši-šalmu: why are you angry with your brother? write my sin on a tablet; send peas and lentils; the wax tablet and the sandals (RS 19.0053)

ane-ugarit-rs-20-0255a-stones-and-ships: Letter to 'my son': send the black ʾalgbṯ stones and the heavy white stones; bring your ships and go up to the Sun your lord, who has spoken before me; a thousand shekels of gold (RS 20.0255,a)

ane-ugarit-rs-86-2236-shipit-baal-wool-f: A 'brother' to Šipiṭ-Baʿlu: the man who fell before you and stayed a month with Ari; speak rightly before the king about Beltaya's words; a talent of wool, silver, fish and turmeric (RS 86.2236)

ane-ugarit-rs-94-2419-tag-garment: Tag to the prefect, 'my brother': a woman's garment and a sash sent; send 30 shekels of silver (RS 94.2419)

ane-ugarit-rs-94-2485-oil-for-wool-egypt: Ahi-malku to Uri-Teššub his brother: may the gods of Ugarit and Tyre sate you with good old age; the oil for the wool, my ship to Egypt (RS 94.2485)

ane-ugarit-rs-94-2996-tarhuntassa-copper: The king of Tarhuntassa to Niqmaddu of Ugarit, his son: I sent for copper for my work; there is none; send red copper; horses and donkeys dead (RS 94.2996)

ane-ugarit-smea-42-ashkelon-thief: The king of Beirut to the king of Ugarit: a man of Ashkelon robbed my harbour master's house, fled to Ugarit and went up to Alašiya; seize him and give him to my man (SMEA 42, p. 5-17)
ane-ugarit-rs-17-0143-ari-teshub-emar: Ari-Tešub of Ušnatu to the king of Ugarit, 'my father': the man of Emar sent for trial with the man of Siyannu and Aru (RS 17.0143)

leads.n: In Genesis Rabbah, Abraham smashes the idols in his father's shop, blames the largest one, and is thrown into a furnace by Nimrod. In the Quran, Abraham breaks the idols except the biggest, tells…
leads.s: In Genesis Rabbah, Abraham smashes the idols in his father's shop, blames the largest one, and is thrown into a furnace by Nimrod.
